title: Balance Bands for Ostomy Supply Program Payment Plans
content:
The balance band replaces the tier's longest number of monthly installments on an Ostomy Supply Program payment plan with a number set on the program's balance due on the day the plan is set up: remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds, less payments and balance adjustments.

| Balance due | Balance band |
|---|---|
| Below USD 250.00 | 3 months (the low-balance months) |
| From USD 250.00 to below USD 500.00 | 5 months (the mid-balance months) |
| USD 500.00 or more | The tier's longest number of monthly installments |

**Boundaries (hypothetical).** USD 249.99 sits in the 3-month band; USD 250.00 in the 5-month band; USD 499.99 in the 5-month band; USD 500.00 takes the tier's longest number of monthly installments (for example 6 on a tier whose longest term is 6).
